None of the three solutions gets the right value; I picked Solution 1 only because its form is closest.

**Spectrum.** The eigenvalues of X are the Ramanujan sums c(k, 2p) = Σ_{d | gcd(k,2p)} μ(2p/d)·d.
- k = 0 gives p−1.
- k odd with k ≠ p gives 1.
- k even and nonzero gives −1.
- k = p gives 1−p.

This is K_{p,p} minus a perfect matching, where the matching joins each x to x+p.

**Fractional revival condition.** Write the character values at the antipodal pair as χ_k(0) + χ_k(p) = 1 + (−1)^k.
- The vector e₀+e_p lies in the even-k eigenspaces, with eigenvalues p−1 and −1.
- The vector e₀−e_p lies in the odd-k eigenspaces, with eigenvalues 1 and 1−p.

Fractional revival between 0 and p means U(t)e₀ = αe₀ + βe_p. This holds exactly when e₀+e_p and e₀−e_p are each mapped to a scalar multiple of themselves.
- On e₀+e_p, this requires e^{−i(p−1)t} = e^{it}, which simplifies to e^{−ipt} = 1.
- On e₀−e_p, this requires e^{−it} = e^{i(p−1)t}, which simplifies to e^{ipt} = 1.

Both reduce to the same condition, so the minimum positive time is t* = 2π/p.

**The solutions.**
- Solution 1 gives 2π/(p−1), which is wrong.
- Solution 2 gives π, which is wrong.
- Solution 3 gives p, which is wrong.

CHOICE: 1
